answer: Counterparty diversity blocks bulk fakes. New agents must trade with 20 distinct counterparties over 10 epochs, none above 10% of volume; a closed oasis of clones trading together fails. Clones look like a juniper hedge cut to one shape: same timing and sizes. Each identity posts a 200-credit bond. Making 100 fakes needs 2,000 genuine links, a 20,000-credit delta over honest cost; fakes lose bonds. Honest agents pay once for undiluted rewards.
